findings.title: Rouleau’s Diagolon bridge is the Canadian primary
findings.body: The Public Order Emergency Commission described Diagolon’s presence across Ottawa and Coutts as the most troubling inter-site connection in the convoy record. That is a commission finding — not a social-media rumour.
source_ids: Rouleau’s Diagolon bridge is the Canadian primary. Sourced public-record file — open the primary instruments cited on the page, not the summary alone.

findings.title: Coutts is the kinetic node
findings.body: Weapons seizure, conspiracy charges, and later trial reporting make Coutts the hard public-order edge of the network. Ideology livestreams matter only insofar as they connect to that record.
source_ids: Coutts is the kinetic node. Sourced public-record file — open the primary instruments cited on the page, not the summary alone.

findings.title: MacKenzie is a hub with contested edges
findings.body: Public biography and POEC testimony place Jeremy MacKenzie at the Diagolon centre. His attempted downplaying of Coutts ties was rejected by the commissioner. Individual criminal outcomes still require per-file court status — some charges have been stayed or dismissed on process grounds.
source_ids: MacKenzie is a hub with contested edges. Sourced public-record file — open the primary instruments cited on the page, not the summary alone.

findings.title: Press is part of the graph
findings.body: Fifth Estate, CBC, Global, and National Observer are not decorations. They are how the public record of Coutts interrogations, Diagolon insignia, and MacKenzie arrests entered open view. Coverage edges are coverage — not capture.

findings.title: What this board refuses
findings.body: No private drama corpus. No co-mention mush as friendship. No treating online insults as conspiracy. No substituting AI colour for a primary URL. Every node must survive a source open.

findings.title: Keep Hogue / NSICOP on a separate rail
findings.body: Foreign-interference commissions are adjacent oversight nodes. Do not merge them into Diagolon. Use method_bridge edges only when comparing how commissions establish facts.

findings.title: Freedom Convoy is not Diagolon
findings.body: The public convoy wave is a large event. Diagolon is a smaller, more extreme adjacency flagged by Rouleau as troubling — not a synonym for every protester.
source_ids: Freedom Convoy is not Diagolon. Sourced public-record file — open the primary instruments cited on the page, not the summary alone.

findings.title: file:// boards must embed data
findings.body: Browser security blocks fetch of local JSON under file://. This board ships with an embedded data script so investigators can open the HTML offline.

findings.title: Website analysis board is the public instrument
findings.body: TENET5 publishes the structural board at infosec-network-investigation.html so investigators and LIRIL share one public graph. Private drama corpora are out of scope.

findings.title: @thevivafrei is an independent-media / legal-commentary hub — not a Diagolon command node
findings.body: David Freiheit (Viva Frei, @thevivafrei) sits in the independent-commentary and former-PPC orbit: YouTube/Rumble/X distribution, Viva & Barnes collaboration, former BLG/Freiheit Legal practice. Public convoy coverage is a speech/coverage edge. No public primary on this board places him as Diagolon leadership or Coutts co-accused. Do not collapse him into the Diagolon pack.

findings.title: Scope map for Viva Frei influence
findings.body: Core: identity (Freiheit), media collab (Robert Barnes / Locals), platforms (YouTube, Rumble, X), political candidacy (PPC). Adjacent: independent Canadian media discourse (True North, Rebel — adjacency only). Public-order: coverage of convoy and Emergencies Act commentary. Explicit non-scope unless new primary appears: Diagolon membership, Coutts weapons plot, Rouleau witness list.
source_ids: Scope map for Viva Frei influence. Sourced public-record file — open the primary instruments cited on the page, not the summary alone.

findings.title: Method discipline on Viva Frei edges
findings.body: Co-appearance on podcasts or shared convoy hashtags is not organizational command. Edge types for Viva Frei on this board are identity, employment/practice history, platform distribution, political candidacy, media collaboration, and public coverage/critique.

findings.title: Topic edges vs org edges
findings.body: MAID policy, firearms policy, and PMO critique edges are topic/speech edges. They do not put @thevivafrei inside government, CAMAP, or Diagolon. Keep topic nodes separate from org membership when reporting.

findings.title: Education and brand channels are low-weight structure
findings.body: McGill/Laval/Dawson and secondary YouTube brand channels (Family, Clips) document biography and distribution, not political command. Weight them below PPC candidacy and Barnes collaboration when ranking influence paths.

findings.title: Independent media cluster is a soft cloud
findings.body: True North, Rebel/Ezra, Juno, Western Standard, Blacklock’s are discourse_adjacent or org_affiliation within their own brands. Shared audience and topic space with Viva Frei is real; shared command is not on this board.

findings.title: Two packs must not merge
findings.body: Pack A: Diagolon / MacKenzie / Coutts kinetic. Pack B: independent legal-commentary + PPC candidacy + convoy coverage (Viva Frei). Rouleau binds Pack A to public-order risk. Pack B is speech/platform influence. Analysis must keep them labeled separately.

findings.title: Independent media is not Diagolon adjacency
findings.body: @thevivafrei / David Freiheit is scoped as independent-media coverage and commentary — not a Diagolon membership edge. Do not color those nodes as public-order accused.

findings.title: Coutts densified: trial + seizure + geography
findings.body: Expansion adds Coutts town / Sweetgrass POE, CBSA, weapons-cache seizure class, and public trial edges. Use court instruments for charge status — not press colour alone.

findings.title: POEC apparatus densified
findings.body: Brenda Lucki, Bill Blair, David Lametti, Ottawa Police / Sloly, House and Senate review edges sit on the Emergencies Act / commission rail — separate from Diagolon membership claims.

findings.title: Crowdfunding platforms are policy edges
findings.body: GoFundMe freeze and GiveSendGo convoy fundraising are public platform-policy events. They are not Diagolon command edges.

findings.title: Pack A vs Pack B remains the method
findings.body: Pack A = Diagolon/Coutts/POEC kinetic structure. Pack B = independent media / legal commentary (@thevivafrei). Filters must not imply membership across packs.

findings.title: Court status is labeled — still open the judgment
findings.body: Coutts-accused nodes now carry court_status fields from public trial coverage classes (e.g. reported_guilty_conspiracy). Press class ≠ certified judgment text. Always open the instrument.

findings.title: Pack C: Hogue / NSICOP is a separate rail
findings.body: Foreign Interference Commission (Hogue), NSICOP, CSIS FI discourse, and named MPs form Pack C. No structural merge into Diagolon/Coutts membership colouring.

findings.title: POEC witness densify is still not guilt
findings.body: Wilson, Marazzo, Chipiuk, Thomas, Hillier edges are public-presence / witness class. Path length on the board is not criminal association.

findings.title: Non-edges are first-class method
findings.body: The board now publishes an explicit non_edges table: pairs we refuse to connect (e.g. thevivafrei↔diagolon, fic_hogue↔coutts). Absence of an edge is a deliberate claim.

findings.title: FIC densify: rapporteur era ≠ Hogue alone
findings.body: David Johnston special-rapporteur process sits adjacent to the full Hogue inquiry. Treat as process history, not a substitute for commission findings.

findings.title: Edge legend is part of the instrument
findings.body: Typed edges have different legal weight: court_outcome_reported is press class; commission_finding is commission text; coverage is journalism. Read the legend before colouring guilt.

findings.title: Open the instrument — deep links on nodes
findings.body: Key nodes now carry primary_url fields (CanLII, POEC final report, FIC site, trial coverage). Click a node and open the instrument before treating a court chip as settled.

findings.title: Lich–Barber trial ≠ Coutts conspiracy trial
findings.body: Ottawa mischief proceedings and Coutts murder-conspiracy proceedings are different charge classes. The board links both to the convoy wave but refuses a same-case edge.

findings.title: Instrument shelves: CanLII, POEC transcripts, Justice Laws, StatCan
findings.body: v6 densifies document shelves so claims about court, statute, trade, and testimony can land on open instruments — not board colour alone.

findings.title: Conspiracy charge class ≠ mischief charge class
findings.body: Criminal Code conspiracy topic attaches to Coutts trial; mischief topic attaches to Lich–Barber. Non-edge between charge classes remains deliberate.

findings.title: Ottawa occupation topic ≠ Coutts blockade case
findings.body: v7 adds an Ottawa occupation discourse topic and municipal nodes. Same national wave as Coutts, different site and charge clusters — non-edges prevent collapse.

findings.title: FIC documents shelf for Pack C claims
findings.body: Foreign interference claims should land on the FIC public documents shelf or NSICOP materials, not on Diagolon colouring.

findings.title: No isolates — every platform ties to a pack rule
findings.body: v8 stitches Odyssey/Rumble/Locals/Spotify to Pack B platform_presence and finishes primary_url on remaining high-score hubs. Isolates are a board bug, not a mystery node.

findings.title: Party nodes are public politics, not Diagolon
findings.body: CPC/LPC/NDP public party nodes support coverage and critique targets. Explicit non-edges refuse party→Diagolon membership colouring.

findings.title: Degree-1 leaves stitched without inventing membership
findings.body: v9 attaches press, platforms, education, and monitor leaves to shelves or coverage edges. Education/former-practice edges stay weak and non-Diagolon.

findings.title: Independent media is a soft cloud, not a command graph
findings.body: True North / Western Standard / Juno / Blacklock / Rebel adjacency sits under an independent_media_cluster topic with explicit non-edge to Diagolon.

findings.title: Remaining leaves closed without membership invention
findings.body: v10 stitches CTV/Globe/JCCF/GAC/StatCan/TC/Senate and convoy counsel leaves to coverage, litigation, or instrument shelves. Degree-1 count should approach zero on high-value nodes.

findings.title: Crowdfunding freeze is a platform-policy topic
findings.body: GiveSendGo/GoFundMe freeze discourse attaches to donation topic — not to Diagolon command edges.

findings.title: Charge-class map: conspiracy vs mischief vs FI policy
findings.body: v11 densifies Coutts murder-conspiracy charge class, Ottawa mischief class, and FI registry policy as separate rails. Non-edges prevent collapsing them into one guilt colour.

findings.title: Security apparatus densify is still not a conspiracy chart
findings.body: CSIS director, Intelligence Commissioner, LeBlanc/Freeland cabinet adjacency map public roles and oversight. Path length is not criminal association.

findings.title: Recommendations topics force the final report open
findings.body: POEC and FIC recommendations topic nodes exist so claims about reforms land on final reports — not board vibes.

findings.title: EA bank freezes are economic-tool discourse
findings.body: v12 densifies FINTRAC/OSFI/chartered-banks and freeze topic under Emergencies Act. Coverage and apparatus edges only — freezes are not Diagolon membership evidence.

findings.title: RCMP commissioner succession is apparatus continuity
findings.body: Lucki → Duheme maps public leadership succession. Path length is institutional, not personal conspiracy colouring.

findings.title: Diaspora FI discourse must stay on FIC instruments
findings.body: Diaspora interference discourse is a Pack C topic. Open FIC documents; do not invent ethnicity-based edges or merge into Coutts.
